final_assessment: Ran the spike at Sal's word, five runs on Sonnet for $0.59 in all. claude plugin eval cannot host orbit's cases: its sandbox gives the shell a read-only workspace, so orbit's CLI cannot write its records (D-rs-6); skill-creator runs cases as subagents graded by a model, not real sessions. R-rop2-2's fallback is taken and proven: a claude -p runner of this repository's own, in fixtures with orbit's skills installed as project skills, graded by orbit's commands afterwards (D-rs-7, Case 4: the emit was written and found). Graders read only what orbit printed or wrote and are shown failing on a known-bad run first (D-rs-8, after two false passes in Case 2); a cut is no worse when every reliably passing fact still passes, reported as mean and spread (D-rs-9); each run uses a packed copy of its commit's CLI (D-rs-10, superseding D-rs-1). A finding for inventory: on a broken CLI the explore body let the session improvise (D-rs-11). No open questions remain.
